_note: Stage 1 and 2 forms carry their line's final ability for now (bible §13 only names some). Revisit when evolutions are pitched.

kiln_heart.name: Kiln Heart
kiln_heart.desc: After it uses a Fire move, its glass hardens: the next hit it takes deals 25% less.

static.name: Static
static.desc: Contact with it may paralyse the attacker (30%).

induction.name: Induction
induction.desc: When hit by a Spark move, its next Spark move deals double damage.

capacitor.name: Capacitor
capacitor.desc: Takes half damage while charging a two-turn move.

spring_heel.name: Spring Heel
spring_heel.desc: On its first turn out, its kicks gain +1 priority.

ambush_jaw.name: Ambush Jaw
ambush_jaw.desc: On its first turn out, its bite moves deal 1.5x damage.

slipstream.name: Slipstream
slipstream.desc: On its first turn out, all its moves gain +1 priority.

unblinking.name: Unblinking
unblinking.desc: It can't be put to sleep or paralysed.
